Name: Galactic Reign
Description: Turn-based strategy of fleet building and territorial conquest, played asynchronously against other commanders.

Achievements.Name: Design a Ship
Achievements.Description: Design a new ship.

Achievements.Name: Win a Battle
Achievements.Description: Win a battle in a multiplayer game.

Achievements.Name: Activate Scanners
Achievements.Description: Analyze a ship in a battle video.

Achievements.Name: A Good Start
Achievements.Description: Earn a victory point.

Achievements.Name: Strike Up the Colors
Achievements.Description: Personalize your forces.

Achievements.Name: Win a Game
Achievements.Description: Win a game.

Achievements.Name: Master and Commander
Achievements.Description: Win 25 games.

Achievements.Name: We Happy Few
Achievements.Description: Win a battle with 50% or less of the enemy's fleet value in a multiplayer game.

Achievements.Name: Once More Unto the Breach
Achievements.Description: Win a battle with less than 10% of your fleet value remaining in a multiplayer game.

Achievements.Name: Scour from the Stars
Achievements.Description: Win two battles in one turn.

Achievements.Name: The Engine of War
Achievements.Description: Colonize three planets in one turn.

Achievements.Name: Always Go At Them
Achievements.Description: Build a fleet of value 3000 by turn four.

Achievements.Name: Overwhelming Force
Achievements.Description: Build a fleet with five or more dreadnaughts in a multiplayer game.

Achievements.Name: You Sank My Dreadnaught!
Achievements.Description: Destroy an enemy dreadnaught in a multiplayer game.

Achievements.Name: I Have the High Ground
Achievements.Description: Control all victory planets at the end of a turn.

Achievements.Name: Sever the Supply Lines
Achievements.Description: Bombard a planet that breaks an opponent's sector.

Achievements.Name: Sticks and Stones
Achievements.Description: Research all technologies in one game.

Achievements.Name: Playing the Long Game
Achievements.Description: Win a game after being down by 10 victory points.

Achievements.Name: Tactician
Achievements.Description: Earn 30 stars in Battle Academy challenges.

Achievements.Name: Master Tactician
